# True Strength Index

*Double-smoothed momentum with a signal line.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **True Strength Index** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Long length | int | `25` |
| Short length | int | `13` |
| Signal length | int | `13` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| TSI color | color | `"#2962FF"` |
| Signal color | color | `"#E91E63"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/tsi.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "True Strength Index", shortTitle: "TSI", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
const longLength = input.int("Long length", 25, { min: 1 }), shortLength = input.int("Short length", 13, { min: 1 });
const signalLength = input.int("Signal length", 13, { min: 1 });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
const t = ta.calc([ta.tsi(src, shortLength, longLength)], (v) => 100 * v);
plot(t, { title: "True Strength Index", color: input.color("TSI color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
plot(ta.ema(t, signalLength), { title: "Signal", color: input.color("Signal color", "#E91E63", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(0, { title: "Zero", color: "rgba(120,123,134,0.5)", style: "dashed" });
```
